voices.name: l00
voices.text: Someone's heart always sank <#0.2#> at the smell of disinfectant.
voices.caption: Someone's heart always sank at the smell of disinfectant.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: One day, they quietly asked. <#0.2#> Why does this smell feel so heavy?
voices.caption: One day, they quietly asked. Why does this smell feel so heavy?

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Then, <#0.3#> a forgotten hospital room came back.
voices.caption: Then, a forgotten hospital room came back.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Left alone the night their mother went home, <#0.2#> a child who couldn't cry.
voices.caption: Left alone the night their mother went home, a child who couldn't cry.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: That smell was bringing back <#0.2#> the feeling they swallowed.
voices.caption: That smell was bringing back the feeling they swallowed.
